label: MacLink Gen 2 Range & Coverage Test – Report 1

link.description: Detailed real-world LoRaWAN range and coverage test report for the MacLink Gen 2 gateway. This section documents indoor multi-floor performance, rooftop deployments, open-space long-range testing up to several kilometers, RSSI and SNR analysis, packet loss behavior, antenna orientation impact, and practical deployment recommendations for industrial, smart building, and outdoor LoRaWAN networks.
